theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_tr_smooth_approx_of_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (u k)) ∧ (∀ k x, x ∉ K → u k x = 0) ∧ (∀ k x, |u k x| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => u k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
